subject.title: Feature: remember new-session workspace, worktree, and model choices

question: Should the Control UI persist per-browser workspace, worktree, and model defaults for new sessions, subject to current catalog validation and explicit-state precedence?
rationale: This adds a user-visible defaulting behavior rather than repairing a documented broken contract, so maintainers must choose the desired UX and precedence policy.

options.title: Sponsor browser-local defaults
options.body: Persist the last explicit valid selections in existing browser-local settings, with recovered drafts and explicit route/catalog targets overriding them.

options.title: Keep stateless new-session defaults
options.body: Retain the current reset behavior and address repeated setup through another workflow rather than persistent UI preferences.

options.title: Narrow the preference scope
options.body: Persist only selected fields after maintainers decide which choices are safe and useful to reuse.

recommendation.title: Sponsor browser-local defaults
recommendation.body: Persist the last explicit valid selections in existing browser-local settings, with recovered drafts and explicit route/catalog targets overriding them.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only identified participant with detailed context for the proposed behavior; repository ownership evidence was not available in the supplied review context.
